units.prompt: EDIT/SKIN the neutral HUMAN BODY in IMAGE1 into the character from IMAGE2. IMAGE1 IS THE LOCKED ANATOMY AND CAMERA MASTER, not merely a mood reference. The new sprite must be a costume worn OVER THIS SAME BODY, not a newly invented tall hero. Keep its elevated HIGH-ANGLE FRONT view looking down25–30deg: top of head/shoulders visible. DO NOT lengthen torso, thighs, shins or shrink head for beauty/slenderness. Character identity may alter waist width slightly; bone LENGTHS are immutable. Image2 supplies clothing/equipment/face identity ONLY, ignore its proportions. Original body template on 1199x1312 canvas: crown approximately y110, chin y340, belt/pelvis y640, near boot y1210, far boot y1020. Preserve corresponding ratios even if whole figure uniformly scaled to fit padding. Anatomical skull→chin about1/5 of crown→sole, don't count hair, beard, helmet crest as extra head. Crisp hand-placed PIXEL clusters, dark stepped outlines and restrained earthy palette EXACTLY like image1; no smooth illustration, gradients, photoreal or small-head fashion proportions. All weapons/boots/hair fully contained with clear margin. True transparent RGBA, no base, shadow, ground, label, glow or additional figure. ONE sprite only. HERA female adult: long golden blond braid viewerLEFT, green short cloak with modest pale-fur shoulder trim and silver clasp, mail shoulders, leather bodice over green tunic, green split skirt panels, leather belt, brown gloves/boots. Keep SAME large anatomical head and short limbs as image1; feminine only by face/braid/narrower waist, NOT elongated body/legs. Small AXE down by viewerLEFT hip and green round white-horse shield viewerRIGHT; adjust only forearm angles to hold them, keep upperarm/forearm lengths. Feet and knee arrangement exactly template. No sword, no royal redcrest/crown.
